subject.title: feat(config): add compaction.thinkingLevel to override thinking level during compaction

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow `agents.defaults.compaction.thinkingLevel` key now, or fold compaction thinking control into the broader per-agent compaction override direction?
rationale: The PR adds a public config key in a compatibility-sensitive compaction path and overlaps an open broader per-agent override proposal, so maintainer product intent is needed after the mechanical local-compaction blocker is fixed.

options.title: Repair and keep this narrow key
options.body: Wire the key through all supported non-Codex compaction paths, preserve explicit Codex-native ignored behavior, and ask for stronger redacted real-behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Fold into broader override work
options.body: Defer this PR and carry the thinking-level behavior into the broader per-agent compaction override implementation once that path is merge-ready.

options.title: Decline the new config surface
options.body: Keep compaction tied to the session thinking level for now and avoid adding another config knob until a stronger product case is accepted.

recommendation.title: Repair and keep this narrow key
recommendation.body: Wire the key through all supported non-Codex compaction paths, preserve explicit Codex-native ignored behavior, and ask for stronger redacted real-behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman is the current assignee and has recent adjacent session/compaction boundary history.
